response.original_title: Tim Miller Citizen Artist: Performing Stories to Change the Ending
response.overview: Citizen Artist explores the life and career of the internationally acclaimed performance artist Tim Miller who, over his long career gave the first known performance onstage about HIV/AIDS, fought a free speech case all the way to the U.S. Supreme Court as one of the “NEA Four,” and started two groundbreaking performances spaces, on in New York and one in Los Angeles which continue to be hubs for creativity and change. He uses his creative work to fight for social change and human decency. A fierce defender of the First Amendment and an uncompromising figure for QFest LGBTQ Spotlight rights and the rights of marginalized people for more four decades, Tim Miller is an artist who performs to change the world for the better.
